chunks: And from him, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn 'Uthman Al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'What is for the one who visits the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?' He said, 'Whoever visits him yearning for him will be among the honored servants of Allah, and will be under the flag of Al-Husayn ibn 'Ali (peace be upon him) until Allah admits them both into Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn with yearning?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) with genuine yearning (shawq) elevates the pilgrim to the rank of honored servants (al-mukarramun). This hadith highlights the eschatological significance of the ziyarah, promising that the visitor will stand under the banner of Imam Al-Husayn on the Day of Judgment, culminating in the dual admission of both the Imam and the devotee into Paradise.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh narrated to me from his father, from Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Abī Ayyūb Ibrāhīm ibn ‘Uthmān Al-Khazzāz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “What is the reward for those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Those who go to his Ziyārah yearning for him will be among Allāh’s (most) honourable slaves. (On the Day of Judgment) they will be under the flag of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.) until Allāh takes them to Paradise with Ḥusain (a.s.).”
